Low Earth orbit is open for business. Our Mission

You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.  

We’re here to give power to the patient. 

For nearly 20 years, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we’re going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc’s marketplace to power access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.

Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from seeking to getting. We don’t want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.

Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.

You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.  

We’re here to give power to the patient. 

For nearly 20 years, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we’re going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc’s marketplace to power access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.

Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from seeking to getting. We don’t want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.

Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.

jobs.title: Account Manager, California/Washington
jobs.description_text: Healthcare is changing, and local medical practices are caught in the middle. They are trying to shift from a system that rewards the volume of procedures to one that rewards the quality of patient care—but navigating that shift is incredibly tough. That’s where you come in. As our Account Manager, you will be the ultimate strategic partner, business coach, and advocate for the medical practices in your portfolio. You are the day-to-day anchor of these relationships, responsible for diving into the data, identifying performance gaps, and working hand-in-hand with doctors and healthcare executives. By helping them master Value-Based Care (VBC) contracts, you directly drive financial success (shared savings) and, most importantly, measurably better health outcomes for the community. Note on Travel: On-site check-ins are key to this role. You can expect to travel in-person approximately 1x per month per account for 2–3 days (supporting accounts in Northern California and the Seattle, Washington area). Exact schedules flex based on client needs, meaning some months may feel lighter or heavier than others. Location Requirement: This is a remote role, but candidates must be based on the West Coast (preferably within driving distance or short regional flight access to Northern California or the Seattle, WA area) to accommodate monthly client visits.

jobs.title: Executive Director, Enterprise Partnerships, Minnesota
jobs.description_text: Executive Directors, Enterprise Partnerships are the business leads for large, strategic hospital and health system accounts. They act as a link between the field and Aledade Centralized support teams, focusing on ACO-specific business operations. Executive Directors partner with Medical Directors to align clinical initiatives with savings goals and provide the business case and direction for field team practice interactions. The Executive Director, Enterprise Partnerships, will be pivotal in building Aledade’s service model in the Minnesota market and beyond for a core group of strategic partners.

jobs.title: Manager, Network Contracting (Remote)
jobs.description_text: The Manager, Network Contracting on the Strategic Payer Partnerships team will support and execute Aledade’s network contracts with national and regional health plans. The role is focused on negotiating and managing a portfolio of network participation agreements. In collaboration with senior leadership, the manager will interface directly with payers to negotiate new agreements and manage renewals. This role will have a strong focus on contract lifecycle management, analysis, and maintaining positive payer relationships. We are flexible with respect to geographic location, and the ideal candidate will be comfortable working remotely/work from home within the U.S. or from our office in Bethesda, MD. Primary Duties:

jobs.title: Outreach Specialist, CACP
jobs.description_text: The CACP Outreach Specialist is the first step in the patient journey and supports the Comprehensive Advance Care Planning (CACP) program through high-volume inbound and outbound outreach. The role primarily manages outbound scheduling and inbound inquiries; educates patients about CACP; addresses reluctance with empathy and professionalism; and schedules facilitation appointments. The specialist follows approved scripts, workflows, SOPs, job aids, privacy requirements, and quality standards while balancing patient-centered service with daily performance expectations. We are flexible with respect to geographic location, and the ideal candidate will be comfortable working remotely/work from home across US time zones. The wage for this position is: $24.52 USD per hour. This range represents the expected base pay for the role across all U.S. locations, based on market data and internal benchmarking. Aledade offers a competitive total rewards package, which includes a company bonus, equity, 401k match, healthcare coverage and a broad range of other benefits. Our team of highly experienced scientists and professionals deliver tailored services for supporting new medicine breakthroughs with best-in-class bioanalytical services.
